components.name: Acid Action
components.css: .ds-acid { display:inline-flex; min-height:52px; align-items:center; gap:9px; border:0; border-radius:999px; padding:0 22px; background:#d8ff45; color:#0c0c0e; font:700 14px/1.2 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; transition:transform .18s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),background .18s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-acid:hover { background:#e6ff7b; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-acid:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #a49dff; outline-offset:3px; }

components.css: .ds-earth { min-height:240px; display:grid; place-items:center; border:1px solid #f3f0e833; background:radial-gradient(circle at 52% 50%,#635bff24,transparent 50%),#07142f; color:#f3f0e8; } .ds-earth strong { font:800 24px/.9 'Bricolage Grotesque',sans-serif; } .ds-earth span { margin-top:8px; color:#d8ff45; font:600 10px/1.3 ui-monospace,monospace; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; }

narrative.overview: This is a motion-graphic experience before it is a conventional marketing page. It borrows the discipline of motion design studies: oversized type, hard cuts between color fields, visible timing markers, offset layers, negative space, and objects that move with a reason. The opening is a black field with a luminous signal object; the story then moves through bone, violet, acid-lime, black, and coral chapters.
keyCharacteristics: Full-viewport chapters instead of repeated cards.

rules.name: The Chapter Color Rule
rules.body: A color owns a scene. Violet belongs to the trigger, acid-lime belongs to connection, bone belongs to editorial clarity, and coral belongs to urgent help.

dos: Do make the first viewport memorable through scale, object, and timing.
Do use real product interactions inside the composed art direction.
Do keep content readable without canvas, WebGL, or motion.
donts: Don't use a generic dark dashboard as the visual language.
Don't turn every feature into an identical rounded card.
Don't let the motion hide the action, the helplines, or the fact that a demo is scripted.
